business_problem: Sutherland needed to move beyond a manual, hard-to-scale threat-detection process so it could protect sensitive customer data and critical business functions more quickly, consistently and cost-effectively across a global services environment.
solution_summary: Sutherland strengthened its existing security operations by layering IBM Security QRadar Suite into its toolset and using it as the central analytics environment for log, network and event monitoring. QRadar performs real-time analysis across security telemetry and applies AI-based anomaly detection, user-behavior analytics and predictive analytics so analysts can identify zero-day attacks and other advanced threats that manual, rule-heavy methods might miss. The company makes particular use of IBM Security QRadar SIEM to collect and correlate data from multiple sources into a unified security view, and integrates the platform with threat-intelligence feeds to support more proactive defense. Sutherland also tailors rules, alerts and reports to its own compliance and operational needs, turning QRadar into a flexible control plane for detection, investigation and response. The result is faster, more targeted security operations with less dependence on manual monitoring.

solution_components.name: IBM Security QRadar Suite
solution_components.role: Analyzes security telemetry with AI to detect threats, anomalies and attack patterns across Sutherland's environment.

solution_components.name: IBM Security QRadar SIEM
solution_components.role: Collects and correlates data from multiple sources to create a unified view of security events and support compliance monitoring.

data_flow: Log data, network traffic and security events from Sutherland's environment are ingested into QRadar, correlated into a unified event view, enriched with threat-intelligence feeds and then used by analysts and alert automations to identify and respond to threats faster.
business_outcome: Sutherland cut detection time dramatically, reduced false positives and manual effort, improved compliance reporting and made its cybersecurity operations more scalable and cost-efficient.
